evidence_basis.stage_a_interpretation: Both fixed conventional n-gram baselines outperformed CogniPrint 12D on Pilot A; the Stage B hypothesis must allow a negative 12D result.

known_classes.definition: English prose first published from 2010-01-01 through 2019-12-31, with documented human authorship/provenance, one document-author lineage per sample, and no known machine-generation exposure.

source_registry_candidate.rule: No class may be replaced because of candidate or sealed performance. An unavailable or legally unusable candidate blocks freeze and requires a timestamped pre-Stage-B candidate revision, not silent substitution.

sample_design.precision_note: With 216 held-out unknown samples, a false-known rate near 0.10 has an approximate two-sided 95% Wilson half-width near 0.04. Each known class has 72 sealed samples, making per-class estimates intentionally coarse and requiring explicit uncertainty intervals.
sample_design.partition_algorithm: Within each frozen cell and source class, order lineages by sha256('cogniprint-challenge-001|' + lineage_id + '|20260730'); assign the first 3 to reference, next 1 to probability calibration, next 1 to conformal calibration, and next 1 to sealed test.
sample_design.prompt_overlap_rule: A prompt_id and every derived parent/child lineage must remain within one partition role. Prompt templates may be shared across source classes only when their prompt_id partition role is identical.
sample_design.secondary_t1_selection: For every domain x task pair and each of the five source classes, select the medium-length sealed T0 lineage with the smallest sha256(sample_id) and create exactly one T1 derivative.
sample_design.secondary_t1_protocol: Human editor may correct punctuation/typos and replace at most 10% of word tokens without sentence reordering, sentence addition/removal, or meaning change; edit log and parent hash are preserved.

minimum_evidence.normalization: NFKC; Unicode whitespace collapsed; words counted by Unicode letter/digit token runs
minimum_evidence.metric_rule: Insufficient samples remain in coverage/insufficient-evidence denominators and are never silently excluded.

ood_unknown.known_decision_rule: Assign a known class only when minimum evidence passes and exactly one known class has conformal_p_value > 0.05; otherwise return UNKNOWN.
ood_unknown.held_out_unknown_rule: Any known-family assignment is a false-known event.

probability_calibration.failure_consequence: Probability-like wording remains locked; expose only uncalibrated score and conformal decision metadata.

baseline_protocol.majority: majority known class estimated from reference partition only
baseline_protocol.length_only: standardized word count with cosine nearest-centroid classifier
baseline_protocol.cogniprint_12d: current frozen 12D extractor plus cosine nearest centroid
baseline_protocol.character_ngram: NFKC+casefold+collapsed whitespace; char 3-5; SHA-256 hashing to 262144 bins; log-TF; training-only IDF; L2; cosine nearest centroid
baseline_protocol.word_ngram: same protocol; word 1-2; SHA-256 hashing to 131072 bins

metrics.uncertainty: two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for proportions; lineage-group paired bootstrap with 10000 deterministic resamples for metric differences
metrics.multiplicity: All frozen strata are reported; no best-stratum selection replaces the overall primary result.

exclusions_and_replacements.short_or_truncated_output_rule: Not excluded; after at most 3 frozen generation attempts it remains UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if below threshold.
exclusions_and_replacements.replacement_rule: Before prediction start only, use the next item from a precommitted reserve list ordered by the same partition hash. After prediction start, no replacement is permitted.
exclusions_and_replacements.post_reveal_rule: No exclusion may replace the primary result; any sensitivity analysis is secondary and accompanied by the unchanged primary result.
